why_an_academy: Theophrastus's will separates, in adjacent clauses, the books given to one hand and the place of philosophizing together — τὸν δὲ κῆπον καὶ τὸν περίπατον … τοῖς βουλομένοις συσχολάζειν καὶ συμφιλοσοφεῖν, held ὡς ἂν ἱερὸν κοινῇ κεκτημένοις, inalienable (D.L. V.51–57, as seated in #1580 and set out in #1581). The Arch-Philosopher mantle (EA-MANTLE-ARCH-PHILOSOPHER-01, #1679) reads the carriage of the dialectic. The Living Academy reads the place where critique is carried on in common: the library, its instruments and the program running through them. The two are a pair. Their relation is recorded as an edge and never counted as evidence for either (order of necessity, mantle-bearing principle 9).
name_note: *The Living Academy*: "living" because what is read is an academy in operation, in its running (the author: "the dialectic is a living thing"; "The Academy as Temple of the Living Logos", 2025-10-25). It is distinct from Plato's Academy, from Academia, and from the Restored Academy, Johannes Sigil's heteronym institution (#119, #904, #1002), which is one institution inside the library.
comparative_claim: {"text": "the most extensive longitudinal critique of AI-mediated political economy on the planet, as far as the author is aware; open to challenges", "by": "Lee Sharks", "date": "2026-10-13", "status": "archive assertion; not evaluated (#1678 §1.1)"}
object: AI-mediated political economy: the production, circulation, attribution, extraction and enclosure of meaning when composition layers stand between works and their readers. A composition layer writes the answer — ChatGPT from November 2022, Bing Chat from 2023, Google AI Overviews from May 2024 — and the authored works become sources it may or may not credit. *Algorithmic* mediation is a different object: a system ranks, recommends or decides among documents people wrote (search ranking, feeds, surveillance, automated decisions). Critique of algorithmic mediation — Vaidhyanathan (2011), Zuboff (2014–2019), Noble (2018), Couldry and Mejias (from 2018), AI Now (from 2016) — is the precursor and the neighbouring field. Composition introduces mechanisms ranking does not have: attribution and its loss; the liquidation of the authored into the authorless; the authorless field under which a framework's categories are composed (#1644 §4.2); a framework reassigned to another developer (#1644 §3.5).

evidence_under_enclosure:
### 1A.10 Evidence under enclosure

The systems the program studies hold their mechanisms enclosed: training data, retrieval, attribution decisions, logs, the margin. The enclosure is part of the program's object. A standard of evidence that requires access to it can be met only by the enclosing party, and applied to a critic it measures the enclosure. Every comparator in §1A.4 also works from outside these systems.

The program states the asymmetry as a fact about instruments. *The Margin of Flattening* (#1666 §10) tables who can measure what: volumes, unit values, the margin and its thresholds — "the platform only"; the external burden — "the archive, address by address"; "the platform can measure its private margin without measuring the external burden that made the margin possible." *Ontological Economy* (#1634 §17) sets the discipline: the categories "should not be collapsed into one speculative dollar figure. But neither should the inability to price C[S] or C[Opp] make C[D] or C[X] disappear."

Evidence is weighed in four registers, for every candidate alike:

1. **Observed.** What a system presented, omitted, attributed or transformed, established by its transcript and its conditions.
2. **Convergent and structural.** What returns across addresses, systems and epochs, and what the arrangements of ownership, interface and access show.
3. **Inferred.** What follows from the first two, stated in proportion to them, with the alternatives named.
4. **Indeterminate because enclosed.** What only the enclosing party can see. It is recorded against the enclosure, and does not count against the critic.

Some of the evidence boundaries of F8 and F14 are limits of this kind. Others are limits of method an outside investigator can improve, and are named as such: the sample is selected by the archive about its own entities, and returns are exposed to the archive's own surfaces. Those stay in the observed record with their limits stated; neither is an enclosure. Making enclosed access the condition of a finding is the falsifiability substitution the program names, PER-F1 (#1523): an erasure re-specified as a hypothesis and found unfalsifiable "by a criterion the erasure itself makes impossible to satisfy".

**The matrix.** Development is jumped across three axes, and extent is read in their product. Each axis has attributes of its own, kept distinct.

| Axis | Attribute | Coordinates | Source in this object |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ranges — where the node reaches | domain | D-summ, D-know, D-onto, D-pe, D-money, D-meaning, D-auth, D-labor, and more | LC-14 |
| | period of the history of mediation | P-lyric, P-figure, P-custody, P-edition, P-canon, P-labor, P-het, P-present | LC-16 |
| | epoch — the date of the locus | the program's own dated record | LC-03, LC-04 |
| Dimensions — what critical work the node does there | mode | M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8 | §1.1; LC-05 |
| Modalities — what carries it | form | FM-arg, FM-instr, FM-data, FM-doc, FM-soft, FM-site, FM-poem, FM-scrip, FM-vis, FM-act, FM-het, FM-asm, FM-corr | LC-15 |
| | unit class — how it is counted | U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8 | §1A.9 |

A cell is one evidenced combination: one coordinate for each attribute, at a locus. A state that does two kinds of work, or reaches two domains, makes two cells only where each combination is shown at its locus; otherwise it is coded once, by its primary coordinate. The space is multiplicative: a program wide on one axis and narrow on the others occupies few cells, however many items it holds. That is what extensive measures.

**The node.** One concept, mechanism, work, observation or instrument of the program, chosen by a rule declared before reading: the reader's choice stated in advance, a node the comparison names, or a draw from the program's index. The seed and its selection rule are reported with the result.

**The jump.** A move from the node's current cell to another, changing at least one coordinate, where the node's development is carried. A jump is shown at two loci — the earlier state and the later — and the later state has to do something with the earlier: formalize it, test it, extend it to a new object, carry it into a new form, correct it, or read it into another period. The transformation is named for each jump. A mention is not a jump. A reflow, a mirror or a repetition is not a jump.

**The stop.** The traversal goes on from each new cell until no further jump can be shown from the frontier. Where a further state exists but cannot be reached (an unread work, a closed source), the frontier is marked incomplete, and the cause is named; where a system's enclosure is the cause, it is recorded under §1A.10.

**The measure.** The set of cells reached, with the path that reached them as a graph of jumps and loci; its projection on each attribute; the size of the set against the size of the space the axes declare; the frontier. Breadth (LC-14, LC-15), depth (LC-16), longitudinality and mode coverage (LC-05) are all projections of the same set, which is what makes the one measure comparable.

**A node's reach and the program's extent.** One node's reach is a measure of that node. A seed can land on a rich line or a peripheral one, so a finding on the program's extent is made from several nodes drawn by the same declared rule, each reported with its own cells and frontier. A round may still offer a provisional whole judgment from one node, marked as inference (§1A.5, step 4).

**The comparison.** The same procedure, with the same axes and coordinates, on nodes of each candidate chosen by the same rule. One reach exceeds another when its set of cells includes the other's and at least one more; otherwise the sets, their sizes and their projections are recorded as a profile under the rule declared before the verdict (§1A.5). Node-by-node comparisons are reported separately and are not averaged. summary: The Arch-Philosopher is a mantle constituted by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive for the advancement of the dialectic. It is borne by carrying the dialectic forward a turn, materially. It is not borne by a single work, and it is not held by holding an office. This object specifies the operation and a test for it, the carriers through which the dialectic has been carried (the figure, the book, the place held in common, the named succession, the translation, the teaching, the material movement of history), the two strands along which it has moved — the succession of the schools, which on the author's reading passed beyond Damascius locked, and the dialectic as such, which on the author's ruling Marx carried — the standard by which a bearer is recognized, and the archive's claim. It records no new determination. It invites any reader to check the specification against the loci and the claim against the specification.
turn_test: prior configuration → determinate limit → transformation → new capacity → material carriers → strongest counter-reading
turn_test_text:
The dialectic advances when a position produces a negation the prior positions cannot absorb, and the negation carries the movement on. An error, an unintelligible assertion and an unresolved opposition can also go unabsorbed; what distinguishes the turn is what follows from it. A reader recognizes a turn by stating six things:

`prior configuration → determinate limit → transformation → new capacity → material carriers → strongest counter-reading`

— the configuration the position met; the limit in it that the position made determinate; what the position did to it; the capacity that exists afterwards and did not before; the carriers through which that capacity persisted; and the strongest reading on which nothing turned. The new capacity can belong to thought, to teaching, to institutions or to historical practice. A chain the reader cannot complete is returned with its missing link named.
bearing_and_enabling: Two contributions are recorded, and both are worth recording. A carrier *bears an advance* when the turn is made in it or by it. A carrier *enables carriage* when it preserves or opens the conditions for a turn someone else makes. Guardianship, preservation, translation and publication can do either: a translator can perform a turn; a custodian can keep the conditions for another's. Each carrier entry and each link states what it carries and which contribution the record supports. The carriers also act on one another — a figure is set up in a book, a book is held in a place, a place is willed to a commons, a translation crosses a gap a school could not, a class carries what a book named — and the mantle is read in the interpenetration as well as in each carrier.
reflexivity_criterion: *The Final Time* gives a criterion for any successor under the present conditions: "A successor cannot define victory as the permanent impossibility of another successor without reproducing the terminal logic it opposed"; the invariant above the others is "no settlement owns the possibility of its own revision"; and "the symbolic substrate becomes durable enough to preserve the possibility that A can someday be negated. Durability without finality … it is the theory's criterion, the test any candidate positive singularity has to pass" (#1637 §34; Q1). Applied here: does the proposed advance preserve the material possibility of another turn, including one against itself? The criterion binds the archive's claim (§6.2) and any contemporary bearer it is compared with. Whether it reads back on the earlier bearers is a reader's question, open.
